sentences.text: Rachna vs Mahender Singh on 3 February, 2025

Item No.1604 Court No.5 Sectio
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 Record Of Proceedings
 Transfer Petition(Civil) No. 108/2025
 Rachna Petitione
 Versus
 Mahender Singh Responden

(For Admission Ia No. 10178/2025 - Ex-Parte Stay)
 Date : 03-02-2025 This matter was called on for hearing today.

For Petitioner(s):
 Mr. Rajendra Singhvi, Adv.
 Ms. Arundhati Chakraborty, Adv.
 Mr. T. R. B. Sivakumar, AOR  For Respondent(s):
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

This transfer petition has been filed by the petitioner-wife seeking transfer of HMA No. 1255 of 2023 filed by the respondent-husband from the Court of Additional Principal Judge (Additional Family Court), Gurugram, Haryana to the Family Court at Barmer, Rajasthan.

entities.text: Additional Principal Judge (Additional Family Court), Gurugram, Haryana
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner-wife that the husband is already appearing in the proceedings of the criminal case instituted by the petitioner pending before the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barmer Reason: for the offences punishable under Sections 498A/323/406 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

entities.text: Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barmer
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Issue notice, returnable in four weeks.
4. In the meanwhile, there shall be stay of further proceedings in HMA No. 1255 of 2023 titled Mahender Singh vs Rachna pending before the Court of Additional Principal Judge (Additional Family Court), Gurugram, Haryana.
 (MANISH ISSRANI) (KAMLESH RAWAT)
